lines.en: I hang beneath the leaf, swaying.
One gust turns me half around.
I cannot move; I can only sway.
My casing gleams in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 我被自己的一根丝挂着
lines.en: A single thread holds me up.

lines.zh: 我随着叶子的起伏上下
lines.en: I rise and fall with the leaf.
Frost creeps over my casing.
I sway around to the sunlit side.
When the stem moves, I move.
I hang and let time pass.
I hold steady in the wind.
I rotate slowly.
Snow falls and I turn whiter.
My casing hangs low.

lines.zh: 我贴着叶背，尽量不显眼
lines.en: I keep to the leaf's underside.
My thread has not slackened.
I hang under the leaf without stirring.
Something inside is slowly changing.

lines.zh: 我封在壳里，什么也不缺
lines.en: Sealed in my casing, I lack nothing.
This leaf shelters me from the wind.
My casing has hardened through.
A quiet snowfield suits me.
I am waiting for a moment.
A thin frost coats my casing.
Something inside shifts.
I hang there, steady.
Time passes slowly for me.
The snowfield's light falls on me.
Do not shake this leaf.
I have hung here for days.
Are you going to pick me off?
I need no help.
What is inside me is not ready.
You look like you are waiting for something.

lines.zh: 我动不了，但我知道你在
lines.en: I cannot move, but I know you are there.
There are still some days to wait.
Touch me and I will fall.
There are only the two of us on the snow.
A crack shows on my casing.
The blow sets me swinging.
I hang lower.
The stirring inside pauses.
I listen and say nothing.
I shorten my swing.
The thread hangs dead straight.
I am still sealed inside.
That bit of shaking is nothing.
There is nothing I can do.
I do not eat anything at all.
I am sealed in; I need nothing.
My shell is sealed; I can't use it
You keep that yourself.

lines.zh: 我封在壳里，连嘴都用不上
lines.en: Sealed in, I cannot even use a mouth.

lines.zh: 你把吃的挂这儿做什么
lines.en: Why hang food here?
I only want to be left quiet.
I can barely see.
Just leave it on the ground.
I have not the least interest in this.
You knocked the leaf.
I swing hard from side to side
My thread is still holding firm.
Touch again and I fall.
The bump presses me to the leaf.
My casing struck the branch.
I sway twice and settle.
The jolt knocks off a layer of frost.
I swing slowly back.
Do not shake that tree.
I am sealed in my casing.
I'm inside the shell and hear none of it
Ask me once I've emerged
I cannot move at all.
This is not that time.
I hang beneath the leaf, silent
There is no other sound in here.
It is quiet inside this casing.
I keep hanging, motionless.
That need not be said aloud.
You have lifted me.
Careful, I will crack.
Where are you carrying me?
One of my threads broke.
This is the wrong spot.
Do not hold me so tightly.
Something in my casing is moving.
Hang me back under the leaf.
I have a small crack now.
The wind is too strong here.
You are shaking my leaf.

lines.zh: 我虽然动不了，但我记得
lines.en: I cannot move, but I remember.
One more step and the shell splits
The one hanging from this leaf is me
What is inside me is nearly ready.
You have spoiled my timing.
I watch you, though I can barely see.
You just wait there.
I will remember this.
It is time for you to go.
I stay turned toward you.

lines.zh: 叶子的晃动我都感觉到了
lines.en: I feel every shake of the leaf.
Something in my casing is straining.
You still have not gone.
Each layer of snow, I count it
I am waiting for you to move off.
It grows less settled in here.
The stirring inside grows louder.

lines.zh: 这已经是我最后一次提醒
lines.en: This is already my last warning.
I moved inside the casing.
A crack opens on my casing.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，什么也没做
lines.en: I jerk, and nothing comes of it.
Something knocked inside me.
You are startled.
I have slipped a little lower.
Half my thread has snapped.
I am still hanging there.
My shell rings from the knock
You shifted back.
A little longer is all.

lines.zh: 我在叶子下结成了一点白
lines.en: A pale point takes shape under the leaf.

lines.zh: 雪地上多了一个小白点
lines.en: A small white nodule appears over the snow.

lines.zh: 我挂在这儿一点点变硬
lines.en: I hang here, hardening by degrees.
Cold here, exactly right.

lines.zh: 我选了一片靠里的叶子
lines.en: I chose a leaf tucked well inside.
My thread has just been set.
I have sealed myself in.
The wind comes off the snowfield.
The first frost on my casing.
I will be here a long while.
Fire comes close and my casing softens.
I fell from under the leaf.
Water seeps into my seams.
The blast shakes me loose.

lines.zh: 箭头在壳上留了道白痕
lines.en: An arrowhead leaves a white score on my shell
Magic heats my casing.

lines.zh: 我本来也不需要吃东西
lines.en: I did not need to eat anyway.
Lightning strikes this tree.
The leaf is gone and I hang in nothing.
